title: Business Central 2026 release wave 1 (BC28): New Early Access Preview Features page (1965, List)
summary: BC28 (2026 release wave 1) adds a new list page, Early Access Preview: New Features (page 1965), which shows some of the new features in the wave with detailed descriptions. From this page users can send feedback on a selected feature, and screenshots, screen recordings and file attachments can now be added. The page also has View Help and Watch Video actions. Optional features are still enabled on the Feature Management page.
key_points: New optional features are initially disabled and can be individually enabled by administrators on the Feature Management page
The Early Access Preview Features page (1965) lists new features for BC28 with detailed descriptions accessible via the Description field
Users can provide feedback directly from the page with compliments, problem reports, or suggestions, now supporting screenshots, screen recordings, and file attachments
The page includes View Help and Watch Video actions to assist users until official documentation becomes available
